title: Software update failed
shortDescription: Roku could not complete a system software update.
fullDescription:
Error 003 appears when Roku attempts to download a firmware update but the connection fails or times out. Often due to spotty WiFi or Roku servers being temporarily unavailable.

Reboot usually clears the state. Persistent 003 needs a factory reset.

fixSteps.title: Move Roku closer to router
fixSteps.instruction: Or use wired Ethernet on Ultra.

title: Roku connected to router but no internet
shortDescription: WiFi link OK but no path to Roku servers.
fullDescription: Error 009 means Roku reached your router but cannot reach the internet. Usually ISP outage, DNS failure, or a router in a weird state.

faq.q: Why does phone work but Roku doesn't?
faq.a: Roku uses specific servers phone doesn't.

title: Wrong WiFi password
shortDescription: Roku cannot join WiFi because the password is incorrect.
fullDescription: Error 014 means Roku reached the correct SSID but authentication failed. Usually just a typo or password change.

fixSteps.title: Check router security mode
fixSteps.instruction: Use WPA2 not WPA3 - some Rokus don't support WPA3.

title: HDCP unauthorized purple screen
shortDescription: Roku cannot establish HDCP with TV/receiver - content protected.
fullDescription: The purple HDCP screen appears when Roku cannot complete HDCP handshake with the TV or AVR. Often triggered by cheap HDMI cables, TV HDMI input issues, or AVR in between.

fixSteps.title: Reseat HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug both ends and reconnect firmly.

fixSteps.title: Swap HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use a High Speed certified cable.

faq.a: Copy protection required for DRM-protected streams.

title: Enhanced remote won't pair
shortDescription: Roku Voice Remote Pro or Enhanced remote not pairing with device.
fullDescription: Enhanced Roku remotes use WiFi direct. If pairing fails, usually batteries are weak or a previous pairing hasn't cleared.

fixSteps.title: Hold pairing button 5 sec
fixSteps.instruction: Inside battery compartment or on back.

faq.a: Voice Remote Pro has rechargeable battery via USB-C.

title: Overheating warning
shortDescription: Red warning appears indicating Roku is too hot.
fullDescription: Roku sticks plug directly into HDMI and can overheat when stuck behind a hot TV. Ultra models overheat when dusty or ventilated poorly.

fixSteps.title: Use HDMI extender
fixSteps.instruction: Roku ships with extender; pulls stick away from hot TV.

faq.a: In original box or request free from Roku support.

title: Black screen after boot
fullDescription: Often wrong TV input, 4K HDR mismatch with TV, or HDMI cable issue.
symptoms: Green LED on Roku but no picture

fixSteps.title: Force 1080p via remote
fixSteps.instruction: Press Home 3x, Up, Right, Up, Up, Up to reset video.

faq.a: Use the remote secret sequence to reset video output.

title: Channel/app keeps crashing
shortDescription: App dumps back to home screen repeatedly.
fullDescription: Often a channel cache issue. Removing and reinstalling the channel clears it.

faq.a: Yes - may need to re-login to the service after reinstall.

title: No audio from Roku
fullDescription: Check audio output settings - Roku may be set to Dolby D+ that TV cannot decode. Try Stereo or PCM-Stereo.

faq.a: Only with eARC HDMI and compatible AVR/soundbar.

title: Low internal storage warning
fullDescription: Roku devices have limited internal storage. Too many installed channels lead to low storage warnings, slow performance, and install failures.

fixSteps.title: Clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Press Home 5x, Up, Rewind 2x, Fast Forward 2x.

faq.a: No - Roku does not support external storage for apps.
